metrics.meanDps: mean of outputDps over ALL trials (a censored trial at the time it actually ran)
metrics.meanTtk: mean time to kill over KILLS ONLY (null when nothing killed)
metrics.killProbability: share of trials that killed inside maxSeconds, Wilson 95% interval
metrics.meanDamage: mean damage dealt per trial (includes overkill)

notes: Fight DPS is a local seeded sample of the Stage 3.1 fight tier: not an event-level reproduction of the game RNG.
Cast When Strikes direct damage is simulated per blow; the card metric still prices CWS as expected damage.
Flow is a constant stack scenario (stacks: 5), not a charge clock, in ordinary fights.
Dual blades use the exchange's averaged held burden before a break (documented drift of a fraction of a tick).
Target shield/armour wear, fists after a break and relay durability are not modelled.
